s01.title: Who is the data controller?
s01.body: The controller of the personal data collected on **SmartCrops** is the site's publisher: **Alexandre Cerveau Audebeau**, reachable at **contact@smartcrops.fr**. **SmartCrops** is a personal, free project with no commercial purpose.

s02.title: What data is collected, and why?
s02.tableAriaLabel: Data collected, purposes and legal bases

account.data: Email, password (stored **hashed**, never in plain text)
account.basis: Performance of the contract (Terms of Use)

s02.note: **SmartCrops** **does not collect** so-called “sensitive” data, **does not sell** your data, and **does not display** advertising.

s03.title: Who has access to your data?
s03.editor: **The publisher** of the site, sole administrator.
s03.ovh: **OVH** (hosting of the server and database, in France/EU);
s03.google: **Google** (only if you choose Google sign-in: Google then processes your authentication data under its own privacy policy).
s03.noThirdParties: No transfer to third parties for commercial or advertising purposes.

s04.title: Does your data leave the European Union?
s04.body: Service data is hosted **in France (OVH)**. If you use Google sign-in, authentication involves Google LLC, which may process data outside the EU under recognised transfer mechanisms (EU–US adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses).

s05.title: How long is your data kept?

items.account: **Account and associated content** — lifetime of the account; effective deletion within 30 days after account deletion.
items.contact: **Contact messages** — 12 months after the last exchange.

s06.title: How is your data protected?
s06.body: Measures in place: passwords stored in hashed form; **HttpOnly** session cookie (inaccessible to scripts); exchanges encrypted over HTTPS; restricted administrator access; configuration secrets kept out of the public repository.

s07.title: What are your rights?
s07.p1: Under the GDPR and the French Data Protection Act, you have the following rights over your data: **access**, **rectification**, **erasure**, **restriction of processing**, **objection**, **portability**, as well as the right to set post-mortem directives.
s07.p2: **To exercise these rights**: write to **contact@smartcrops.fr** from the address associated with your account (identity verification may be requested). Answer within one month. You can delete your own content (gardens) from the application; account deletion is handled on request at the address above (answer within one month).
s07.p3: If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can lodge a complaint with the **CNIL** (www.cnil.fr), the French data protection authority.

s08.title: Minors
s08.body: The service is not intended for children under 15 without the consent of the holder of parental authority (article 45 of the French Data Protection Act).

s09.title: Cookies
s09.intro: Current state of **SmartCrops**: two **strictly necessary** cookies (**HttpOnly**) and preferences stored in the browser's localStorage (language, theme, units, banner dismissal). **No advertising or audience-measurement cookies.** Strictly necessary trackers are exempt from consent (CNIL): clear information is sufficient.

s01.title: Purpose
s01.body: These Terms of Use govern the use of **SmartCrops** (the “Service”), a web application for managing virtual gardens: plant library, garden planning and related features. Using the Service constitutes acceptance of these Terms.

items.free: The Service is **free of charge**. Browsing the library is open to everyone; some features (garden creation, profile, suggestions) require an account.
items.asIs: The Service is a **personal project under active development**: it is provided “as is”, with no commitment of availability, continuity or service level. Features may evolve, be added or removed.

items.accuracy: You agree to provide accurate information and to keep your credentials confidential. Any activity carried out through your account is deemed to be yours.
items.signup: You can sign up with email/password or via Google. You may request the deletion of your account at any time (see the Privacy Policy).

items.ownership: The content you create (gardens, notes, plant suggestions) **remains yours**. You grant the publisher the technical licence strictly necessary to host it, back it up and display it to you.
items.conduct: You agree not to publish unlawful or offensive content, or content infringing third-party rights. **Plant suggestions** are subject to moderation and may be accepted, edited or declined without justification.
items.removal: The publisher may remove any content manifestly contrary to these Terms.

s05.title: Botanical data — information, not prescription ⚠️
s05.p1: Botanical information (including edibility, toxicity, so-called medicinal uses and growing periods) is **automatically aggregated from third-party sources** (GBIF, Trefle, Perenual) and provided **for purely informational and indicative purposes**. Despite the care taken, it may be **incomplete, outdated or incorrect**.
s05.p2: **Under no circumstances does it constitute medical, veterinary, dietary or professional advice.** Never eat a plant or make any therapeutic use of it on the sole basis of the Service's information; always double-check with qualified sources. The publisher declines all liability for decisions made on the basis of this information.

s06.title: Intellectual property
s06.body: See the Legal Notice (“Intellectual property” section): elements specific to the Service on the one hand, third-party data and media under their respective licences on the other. Using the Service grants no rights over these elements beyond personal consultation.

items.bestEffort: The publisher strives to keep the Service running properly but guarantees neither the absence of errors, nor continuous availability, nor data retention: keep a copy of anything you value.
items.links: The Service may contain links to third-party sites whose content the publisher does not control.
items.liability: The publisher's liability can only be engaged in case of proven fault, and within the limits permitted by law for a free service.

s08.title: Suspension and termination
s08.body: The publisher may suspend or delete an account in case of breach of these Terms (notably the “User content” section), after a warning except in urgent cases. You may stop using the Service and request the deletion of your account at any time.

s09.title: Changes to the Terms
s09.body: These Terms may be amended to follow the evolution of the Service. The applicable version is the one online, dated at the top of the page. In case of substantial change, a notice will be displayed; continued use constitutes acceptance.

s10.title: Governing law

hero.subtitle: One place to discover plants, plan your garden, and learn as you grow.
hero.imageAlt: Garden at sunrise with morning light

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: Gardening knowledge is scattered across dozens of sites, forums, and seed packets. SmartCrops brings it together in one place — a detailed plant library and practical tools — so you can spend less time searching and more time growing.

project.title: The project
project.p1: **SmartCrops** is an open, portfolio-driven project — a real, working application rather than a demo. Everything you see runs on a live backend, with public source code.
project.p2: At its core: a botanical library aggregating multiple sources (GBIF, Trefle, Perenual), a drag-and-drop garden planner, and — on the roadmap — AI-, weather-, and IoT-assisted recommendations to tailor advice to your garden.
